notes: Single style on the page. Year = 1st & 2nd numerical digits, month = 3rd & 4th numerical digits (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Serial is all digits, so character and digit counting agree. Page example 850304091 decodes to March 1985. No held styles on this page; page images are data-plate photos, not decode charts. Kept separate from Sunbelt and Sunburst, which have their own pages.
